title: VC-TR-OBJECT-AUTHZ: Object fetched by request ID without an ownership or tenant filter
user_impact: Any signed-in user may read or change other users' records (IDOR / cross-tenant leakage).

root_cause.hypothesis: app/api/invoices/route.ts:2 looks up a record by a request ID; no user/tenant filter appears in the file. Expected: Objects looked up by a client-supplied ID are scoped to the signed-in user or tenant.
